name: Get-Volume
title: Inspect Windows Storage Volumes
summary: Lists drive letters, file systems, health state, capacity, and remaining space.

examples.command: Get-Volume | Select-Object DriveLetter, FileSystemLabel, HealthStatus, SizeRemaining, Size
examples.description: Shows storage capacity and health without modifying a volume.

permissions.notes: Viewing common volume information normally works without elevation.

risk.warning: This command only reads volume information.

output_fields.name: HealthStatus
output_fields.description: Windows assessment of the volume state.

output_fields.name: SizeRemaining
output_fields.description: Unused capacity available on the volume.

common_errors.meaning: A protected or managed storage provider may require administrator access.
